name: Subodh Gidh
story: Subodh Gidh was a GIS specialist in Hamilton City Council’s Information Services team during the September 2008 user-conference debate. He supported a broader programme that exposed staff to other GIS providers, explaining that organisations used multiple applications while employees often had approval to attend only one conference.

Subodh Gidh, GIS Specialist at Hamilton City Council, argued for a more open format because some organisations already used more than one GIS application and staff often struggled to get approval for even one conference.
